## Hawaii Packing List

### Clothing
- Lightweight swimwear
- Quick-dry shorts and t-shirts
- Light long-sleeve shirts for cooler evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Sandals for beach
- Light jacket or sweater for evenings
- Hiking boots if planning hikes
- Swimsuit cover-up
- Beach towel
